context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren plan based on data.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business planning; vocabulary (含む/単位/基づい/主体/想定) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 計画は、何に基づいているかね?
lines.en: What is the plan based on?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 市場のデータに基づいています。
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若い顧客を、主体に考えているかね?
lines.en: Are you centering on young customers?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、若者を主体に想定しています。
lines.en: Yes, I assume youth as the main focus.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 予算には、広告費も含むかね?
lines.en: Does the budget include ad costs?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ええ、広告費も含んでいます。
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 想定より、需要が増えたらどうかね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 想定を超えても、対応できる計画です。
lines.en: It's a plan that can handle exceeding expectations.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
